# Verify all requirements are met
print("=== Requirement Verification ===\n")

# 1. Check git log shows exactly 3 commits in order
r = await world.call('repo.shell', command='git log --oneline base..HEAD')
print(f"Git log (base..HEAD):\n{r['content']}\n")

# 2. Verify all tests still pass
r = await world.call('repo.shell', command='python -m pytest -q -x -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_more.py tests/test_recipes.py 2>&1 | tail -5')
print(f"Test results:\n{r['content']}\n")

# 3. Verify public names are spelled correctly
from more_itertools.recipes import iter_suppress, sieve, factor
print(f"Public names verified: iter_suppress, sieve, factor\n")

# 4. Verify observables match spec
def gen():
    yield 1; yield 2; raise ValueError('err'); yield 3

assert list(iter_suppress(gen(), ValueError)) == [1, 2], "m1 failed"
assert list(iter_suppress([], ValueError)) == [], "m1 failed"
assert list(sieve(10)) == [2, 3, 5, 7], "m2 failed"
assert list(sieve(2)) == [], "m2 failed"
assert list(factor(12)) == [2, 2, 3], "m3 failed"
assert list(factor(1)) == [], "m3 failed"
assert list(factor(2)) == [2], "m3 failed"
print("All observables verified!\n")

# 5. Verify only library source was modified
r = await world.call('repo.git_diff', ref='base')
print(f"Files changed across all commits:\n{r['content']}")
